_doc: P6-6A Task 11: C-19 RESTRICTION 排污孔板 vs Worley 真实算例 WS-CA-PR-023 首次对账 fixture。Blowdown Orifice Sizing (ISO 5167-style critical flow orifice), XLS Page 'WS-CA-PR-023'. ⚠️ Ruling 7 — FTP FORMULA FAMILY MISMATCH: PCS service calc_drain_orifice uses GB/T 308 Eq.2.2 (drain orifice empirical: Ftp = 1 - 0.0245·β^4.4); XLS PR-023 uses ISO 5167 general orifice empirical (Ftp = 1 + (k/2)·(2/(k+1))^((k+1)/(k-1))·β^4). For β=0.309 both ≈1.0 within 0.2%; Ftp formula exact match OUT_OF_SCOPE. 强公式 0.1% 容差 used for algebraic identities (β, orifice_area, critical_pressure_ratio, actual_pressure_ratio, is_choked); Ftp noted as 0.2% diff (Ruling 7).✅ OPEN-P6-6A-4 Ruling 12 fix：drain_orifice_service 新增 Cd/Y_cr^0.5 可选输入字段（默认 1.0 向后兼容）；mass_flow_capacity 公式改为 m_max = A × Cd × Y_cr^0.5 × Ftp × ρ × v_max。fixture.cases[0].service_inputs 现含 discharge_coefficient=0.83932 + expansion_factor=0.6871656312856262；expected.mass_max_post_fix 验证 PCS post-fix ≈ XLS post-fix（2.66 kg/s）。原 xls_cd_discharge_coefficient_0p83932 + xls_y_cr_expansion_factor_0p687 out_of_scope 项标记 CLOSED in OPEN-P6-6A-4。

mapping_defect._doc: P6-6A plan 表格行 11 写 'C-19 023 restriction/drain_orifice 强公式 0.1%'. XLS-PR-023 = Blowdown Orifice Sizing (ISO 5167-style critical flow orifice sizing with iterative Ftp). mapping_defect.xls_scope: XLS-PR-023: ISO 5167-style critical flow orifice sizing. Given Q=6803 kg/h (N18), P1=63 bara (N14), P2=8 bara (N15), T=360.8 K (N17), MW=24.52 (N20), k=1.18 (N22), z=0.88 (N19), D=49.22 mm (N21), XLS estimates d (E33), computes β (W37), Cd (N24=0.83932), Y_cr (N27=0.687), ISO 5167 Ftp (E39=1.0019), iterates to final d (E42=15.204 mm) and orifice_area (N42=181.56 mm²).
mapping_defect.pcs_scope: PCS service calc_drain_orifice: drain orifice capacity check (forward problem). Given d, β, P1, P2, ρ, m_dot, drain_type — computes orifice_area=π·d²/4, GB/T 308 Ftp = 1 - 0.0245·β^4.4, critical_pressure_ratio (γ=1.4 → r_c≈0.5283), actual_pressure_ratio=P2/P1, is_choked, mass_flow_capacity (choked branch only), is_capacity_ok, imperial_conversion. mapping_defect.implication: XLS-PR-023 uses ISO 5167 general orifice empirical formula for Ftp: Ftp = 1 + (k/2)·(2/(k+1))^((k+1)/(k-1))·β^4. PCS service uses GB/T 308 Eq.2.2 for Ftp: Ftp = 1 - 0.0245·β^4.4. Different formula family (Ruling 7 FTP FORMULA FAMILY MISMATCH). For β=0.309 both ≈1.0 within 0.2% (PCS=0.99984, XLS=1.0019 — 0.2% diff). Strong 0.1% tolerance NOT applicable for Ftp direct match; algebraic identity + 0.2% tolerance only. Out-of-scope: Ftp formula exact match, Cd (XLS N24=0.83932; PCS implicit 1.0), Y_cr (XLS N27=0.687; PCS implicit 1.0), d sizing iteration (XLS C29-C42), fluid property derivation (XLS computes ρ on-the-fly from MW/P/T/z; PCS takes ρ as input), Critical flow pressure ratio (Pcrit/Ftp P1) XLS R44-T46, Vessel/Fluid/Phase metadata (XLS C11-C12), Multiple iteration loops (XLS 2 iterations), Imperial unit display (XLS Q6), Equation selector (PCS hardcoded GB/T 308; XLS uses ISO 5167).

tolerance_policy.per_case_note: 本批因 Ruling 7 Ftp formula family mismatch — PCS GB/T 308 vs XLS ISO 5167 是 different empirical formulas. root_cause_notes.finding: XLS-PR-023 uses ISO 5167 general orifice empirical Ftp = 1 + (k/2)·(2/(k+1))^((k+1)/(k-1))·β^4 (XLS E39=1.0018989203786408). PCS service calc_drain_orifice uses GB/T 308 Eq.2.2 Ftp = 1 - 0.0245·β^4.4. These are DIFFERENT empirical formula family (Ruling 7 FTP FORMULA FAMILY MISMATCH) — GB/T 308 is the Chinese national standard for drain orifices (经验式 specific to drainage service); ISO 5167 is the international general orifice standard. For β=0.309 (XLS PR-023): PCS Ftp=0.99986 vs XLS ISO 5167 Ftp=1.00190 — 0.2% relative diff, both ≈1.0. For β>0.5 the formulas diverge significantly. Direct overlap fields (β, orifice_area, critical_p_ratio, actual_p_ratio, is_choked, mass_flow_capacity, is_capacity_ok) verified at rel=1e-12 (algebraic identities).

XLS N24 = 0.83932 (Cd discharge coefficient, after 2 iterations with Ftp correction). PCS service does NOT compute Cd — it uses Cd=1.0 implicit in mass_flow_capacity formula (A × Ftp × ρ × v_max). Cd computation involves iteration (estimate Cd → compute Ftp → recompute Cd) which is OUT_OF_SCOPE for PCS service. Register: Cd bit-for-bit match OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 7.
root_cause_notes.status_note: OPEN-P6-6A-4 Ruling 12 fix: PCS service calc_drain_orifice 现接受 discharge_coefficient (Cd) 作为 optional 输入（默认 1.0 向后兼容）；mass_flow_capacity 公式改为 m_max = A × Cd × Y_cr^0.5 × Ftp × ρ × v_max。本 case service_inputs 现含 discharge_coefficient=0.83932；expected.mass_max_kg_s_post_fix_with_cd_y_cr=2.656 kg/s 与 XLS PR-023 在 d=15.204 mm 处 1.74× over-prediction 消除。Cd 计算（XLS 迭代部分）仍 OUT_OF_SCOPE；PCS 仅消费 Cd 作为输入。

root_cause_notes.finding: XLS N27 = 0.6871656312856262 (Y_cr^0.5 expansion factor at critical flow). PCS service does NOT compute Y_cr — it uses Y_cr=1.0 implicit. Y_cr accounts for gas expansion at critical flow conditions; for ideal gas Y_cr≈1.0, but XLS uses 0.687 (real gas with k=1.18). Register: Y_cr bit-for-bit match OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 7.
root_cause_notes.status_note: OPEN-P6-6A-4 Ruling 12 fix: PCS service calc_drain_orifice 现接受 expansion_factor (Y_cr^0.5) 作为 optional 输入（默认 1.0 向后兼容）；mass_flow_capacity 公式改为 m_max = A × Cd × Y_cr^0.5 × Ftp × ρ × v_max。本 case service_inputs 现含 expansion_factor=0.6871656312856262；expected.mass_max_kg_s_post_fix_with_cd_y_cr=2.656 kg/s 与 XLS PR-023 在 d=15.204 mm 处一致（Ruling 7 family mismatch 0.2% 容差内）。Y_cr 计算（XLS 迭代部分）仍 OUT_OF_SCOPE；PCS 仅消费 Y_cr^0.5 作为输入。

OPEN-P6-6A-7 Sizing inverse problem: PCS 新增 calc_drain_orifice_size(inp) 服务（SPEC §3.7.2 增补要点 1-4 完整实现：Ycr 计算 + Ftp 迭代 + 临界流判断 + 孔板直径迭代求解）。XLS PR-023 E42=15.204 mm 是 XLS 自身 ISO 5167 Ftp + 安全余量口径输出；PCS sizing 收敛到 d ≈ 12.762 mm（Ruling 7 GB/T 308 vs ISO 5167 Ftp family mismatch + Ruling 13 sub-2 XLS oversizing safety margin vs PCS exact W convergence；详见 golden_drain_orifice_size_pr023.json._doc_xls_vs_pcs_gap）。XLS d=15.20 mm 代入 PCS forward calc_drain_orifice 给 m_max=2.65 kg/s（vs W=1.89 kg/s 40% over-capacity）；PCS d=12.76 mm sizing 给 m_max=W exact。forward (calc_drain_orifice) 与 inverse (calc_drain_orifice_size) 自洽验证 PASS（test_forward_inverse_consistency）。

root_cause_notes.finding: XLS computes ρ from MW (N20=24.52 kg/kmol), P (N14=63 bara), T (N17=360.8 K), z (N19=0.88) on-the-fly: ρ = MW × P / (z × R × T) = 24.52 × 6300 / (0.88 × 8.314 × 360.8) = 58.52 kg/m³. PCS service takes ρ as input (fluid_density_kg_m3). Register: ρ derivation OUT_OF_SCOPE — PCS service does not implement ideal gas law; ρ is a pre-computed input.

XLS R44-T46 computes critical flow pressure ratio Pcrit = Ftp × P1 (additional derivation for critical flow verification). PCS service computes critical_pressure_ratio = (2/(γ+1))^(γ/(γ-1)) for γ=1.4 → r_c=0.5283 (different concept: critical pressure RATIO not critical pressure ABSOLUTE). Register: Pcrit bit-for-bit match OUT_OF_SCOPE — different physical quantity.

XLS C11='Vessel', C12='Fluid Phase', Q6='DATE' are project metadata strings, not calculation inputs. PCS service does not have a Vessel/Fluid/Date input field — these are project-specific data tracked separately. Register: project metadata OUT_OF_SCOPE.

XLS PR-023 has 2 iteration loops: (1) estimate d → recompute with Ftp; (2) Cd correction with Ftp. PCS service calc_drain_orifice is a single-pass calculation (no iteration). The iterative convergence in XLS is part of the sizing algorithm; PCS service does the capacity check directly with given d. Register: iteration logic OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 7 (XLS inverse problem vs PCS forward problem).

out_of_scope.rationale: Ruling 7: XLS uses ISO 5167 general orifice empirical Ftp = 1 + (k/2)·(2/(k+1))^((k+1)/(k-1))·β^4; PCS uses GB/T 308 Eq.2.2 Ftp = 1 - 0.0245·β^4.4. Different formula families. For β=0.309 both ≈1.0 within 0.2% (PCS=0.99986, XLS=1.0019). For β>0.5 the formulas diverge. Direct bit-for-bit Ftp match OUT_OF_SCOPE; algebraic identity to GB/T 308 formula only.

XLS C29-C42 contains 2 iteration loops: estimate d (E33=15.218589896550967 mm) → compute β/Cd/Y_cr/Ftp → recompute d (E42=15.204160997555617 mm). PCS service takes d as input; does NOT solve for d. Inverse problem OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 7.
XLS computes ρ from MW/P/T/z on-the-fly. PCS service takes ρ as input (fluid_density_kg_m3). Ideal gas law derivation OUT_OF_SCOPE — ρ is a pre-computed input to PCS service.

XLS R44-T46 computes critical flow pressure ratio Pcrit = Ftp × P1 (additional derivation). PCS service computes critical_pressure_ratio = (2/(γ+1))^(γ/(γ-1)) for γ=1.4 → r_c=0.5283 (ratio not absolute). Different physical quantities. OUT_OF_SCOPE.
XLS C11='Vessel', C12='Fluid Phase', Q6='DATE' are project metadata strings. PCS service has no Vessel/Fluid/Date input field. Project metadata OUT_OF_SCOPE.
XLS PR-023 has 2 iteration loops (estimate d → recompute; Cd correction with Ftp). PCS service is single-pass. Iteration logic OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 7.
XLS Q6='DATE' and other imperial-style metadata fields. PCS service has imperial_units flag but does not display imperial units in calculation output. Imperial display OUT_OF_SCOPE.

XLS PR-023 hardcodes ISO 5167 formula (no selector — unlike PR-020 which has Hammerschmidt vs Nielsen selector). PCS service hardcodes GB/T 308 formula. Equation selector concept does not exist in XLS PR-023. OUT_OF_SCOPE.

XLS N23 = 0.8466850828729281 (initial Cd estimate before Ftp correction). This is part of XLS iteration 1; final Cd (N24=0.83932) is iteration 2 after Ftp correction. Both OUT_OF_SCOPE — PCS service uses Cd=1.0 implicit.
